name: Omavisor
author: Deus Vult Digital
description: A Dynamic-Island hub in the center of the Omarchy bar: clock, weather, media, capture, timers, updates, and live activities any script can push.

barWidget.description: Clock, weather and live activities that expand into a hub

schema.label: Mode
schema.description: replace: Omavisor shows clock and weather. wrap: keep omarchy.clock/omarchy.weather and show only activities.

schema.label: Clock format (side bar)
schema.description: The clock on a left or right bar, a short stack; \n starts a new line.

schema.label: Hub tabs
schema.description: The tabs in the hub's strip, in this order; the first opens first. A tab not listed is hidden but still opens by name (omavisor expand). Not set: Now playing, Calendar and Activity; the rest are a switch away in Settings.

schema.label: Pill items
schema.description: What the collapsed pill shows, in this order; the badge sits around the rest. While a player plays, one spot left of the clock shows Album art (media) or Audio levels (meter), whichever is listed first; the spot keeps its room while either is listed, so the pill never changes width for music. Not set: clock, album art and badge, or glyph and badge in wrap mode.

schema.label: Hub opacity (%)
schema.description: How solid the hub's card (and the cap around the pill while it is open) is: 100 is the theme's popup background as it is, lower lets the desktop show through. Text and controls stay solid.

schema.label: Hub corners
schema.description: The hub's corners and the joint where it meets the pill. auto: follow the theme (square on a square theme, its rounding otherwise). square: always square. round: always curved, the theme's rounding or a small curve on a square theme.

schema.label: Wave style
schema.description: How the Now playing view draws the sound: bars, mirror, wave or dots. A click on the wave steps through them. With cava installed it follows your audio (read only while the view is open and a player plays); without, it is a drawing.

schema.label: System stats refresh (ms)
schema.description: How often CPU and memory refresh while the System tab or stats tile is on screen. Temperatures and GPU refresh every 5 s at most, disk every 30 s.

schema.label: Temperature unit
schema.description: auto: Fahrenheit where the weather location (or your locale) uses it.

schema.label: Load web album art
schema.description: When a player has no local art file, load the album art it publishes as a web link (Spotify, browsers), for the current track only. Off: only local art, and the music icon otherwise.
